report_name: Silver Fox Spreads ValleyRAT via Signed Adware

threat_actors.name: Silver Fox
threat_actors.description: A cybercrime group distributing the ValleyRAT backdoor by hiding it within a legitimately signed Chinese adware application, 'QN Wallpaper', and using DLL sideloading for defense evasion.

attack_patterns.name: DLL Side-Loading
attack_patterns.description: The legitimate, signed executable QnWallpaper.exe was used to load a malicious DLL named libcef.dll placed in the same directory, executing its code within a trusted process.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The malware installer attempts to disable Windows Defender by modifying the registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware.

attack_patterns.name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
attack_patterns.description: ValleyRAT creates autorun entries to ensure it runs on system startup for persistence.

attack_patterns.name: Keylogging
attack_patterns.description: ValleyRAT has the capability to perform keylogging to collect user input.

attack_patterns.name: Screen Capture
attack_patterns.description: ValleyRAT can capture screenshots of the compromised system.

malware.name: ValleyRAT
malware.description: A full-featured remote access trojan backdoor distributed by the Silver Fox group. It is delivered via DLL sideloading using the 'QN Wallpaper' adware application and provides attackers with complete control over the infected system.

tools.name: QN Wallpaper
tools.description: A legitimate, digitally signed Chinese adware application that was abused by the Silver Fox group to sideload the malicious libcef.dll, which contains the ValleyRAT backdoor.

indicators.name: ValleyRAT DLL Sideloading via QnWallpaper.exe
indicators.pattern:
title: ValleyRAT DLL Sideloading via QnWallpaper.exe
id: 2b8c1f3a-5d6e-4b9f-8c1d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the legitimate 'QnWallpaper.exe' process loading a potentially malicious 'libcef.dll' from its local application directory, a technique used by the Silver Fox group to deploy ValleyRAT.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/valleyrat-backdoor-hides-in-signed.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-31
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\QnWallpaper.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\libcef.dll'
  filter_legit_path:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_path
indicators.description: Detects the DLL sideloading behavior where the legitimate QnWallpaper.exe loads a malicious libcef.dll from a non-standard directory.

indicators.name: ValleyRAT Disables Windows Defender via Registry
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Windows Defender Disabled via Registry Modification
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects attempts to disable Windows Defender by setting the 'DisableAntiSpyware' registry key to 1. This technique is used by ValleyRAT installers.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/valleyrat-backdoor-hides-in-signed.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-31
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: registry_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    EventType: 'SetValue'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware'
    Details: '1'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the specific registry modification used by the ValleyRAT installer to disable Windows Defender.

indicators.name: ValleyRAT Sideloading File Artifacts
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: ValleyRAT Sideloading File Artifacts
id: 9e8f7a6b-5c4d-4e3f-2a1b-0c9d8e7f6a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects file or process events involving 'QnWallpaper.exe' or 'libcef.dll', which are used in ValleyRAT DLL sideloading attacks.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/valleyrat-backdoor-hides-in-signed.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-31
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\QnWallpaper.exe'
      - '\libcef.dll'
  filter_legit_libcef:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\libcef.dll'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_libcef
indicators.description: Detects the presence of file artifacts associated with the ValleyRAT DLL sideloading campaign.
